description.p: LinSpectacles is a modular suite of read-only Linux inspection utilities with independently portable applets.
The RPM installs the LinSpectacles Hub application. Applets and Hub Modules may be user-installed or provided as immutable RPM-managed system components.
Completes the official offline Hub Module catalogue with Boot Environment and System Identity.
Adds dual-source applet and Hub Module discovery for RPM installs, with user overrides taking precedence over system-installed components and package-manager ownership respected.
Clarifies LinSpectacles Hub identity in About surfaces and removes temporary RPM package-name obsoletion ahead of the finalized package taxonomy.
Adopts the LinSpectacles Hub package and repository identity while preserving the visible LinSpectacles application identity, command and user-owned component model.
Renames the Fedora/COPR package to linspectacles-suite and adds upgrade compatibility from the former linspectacles package; application runtime behavior is unchanged.
Improves RPM and AppStream identity metadata for package and software-center presentation; application runtime behavior is unchanged.
